name: safelinks
title: Safe Links Decoder
description: Reveal the destination, wrapper chain and risk flags of rewritten email links with local, offline decoding.
author: henry_rausch

commands.name: decode-clipboard
commands.title: Decode Safe Link from Clipboard
commands.description: Decode the selected text, falling back to the clipboard, without opening the link.

commands.name: decode-input
commands.title: Decode Safe Link…
commands.description: Paste a rewritten link or message to see the real destination and risk flags.

preferences.name: stripTrackingParams
preferences.title: Copying
preferences.label: Copy links without tracking parameters
preferences.description: Remove utm_*, gclid, fbclid, msclkid and mc_eid from copied or pasted links. The displayed result stays exact.
